newsitem.title: UK: First UK Air Freight Forum set for Nov 5.
newsitem.headline: First UK Air Freight Forum set for Nov 5.

text.p: The first meeting of the UK Air Freight Forum will take place on November 5, and include airline, freight forwarder and shipper representatives,the Forum's co-ordinator, Martin Richards said.
He added in a statement that it will provide an opportunity for the industry's" suppliers and customers to meet on neutral ground to debate matters of of mutual interest".
The Forum is intended to meet twice yearly to discuss issues such as quality standards, efficient operations, as well as customer supplier needs, he said.
Carriers invited to attend include Canadian Air Cargo, Lufthansa Cargo, British Airways World Cargo, KLM Royal Dutch Airlines, Emirates, Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd and American Airlines.
There will also be representatives from the British International Air Freight Association (BIFA) and seven leading shippers.
